entries.2143112820880c71: Built around two core technologies, tribology (friction, wear and lubrication) and damping (vibration control), it has a product line addressing social challenges, including self-lubricating bearings that require no lubrication and reduce energy loss from friction and wear, and seismic isolation and damping devices for earthquake countermeasures in buildings. It has accumulated development and manufacturing experience as a specialized manufacturer of oilless bearings since its founding in 1939, and its own devices have been used in Japan's first seismic-isolation building.
entries.240c5f37e6f6dd1c: It sets out its long-term vision 'OILES 2030 VISION' (contributing to the realization of a sustainable society through friction, wear and vibration technologies + X), and is working on the Medium-Term Management Plan 2024-2026, starting from fiscal 2024. Its medium-term management policy is to concentrate management resources on growth markets, improve productivity through business reform and the pursuit of production technologies, contribute to stakeholders, and manage finances with an awareness of capital efficiency. By business, it sets out the following: for General Bearing Equipment, deployment of strategic products into growth areas such as semiconductor manufacturing equipment and the renewable energy market; for Automotive Bearing Equipment, product development responding to the spread of EVs and autonomous driving, and developing non-Japanese customers in growth markets such as China and India; for Structural Equipment, expanding share with large products for infrastructure renewal and urban data centers; and for Building Equipment, strengthening activities in the renovation and remodeling market.
entries.2a43cd73b15e9db6: A business model in which the company develops, manufactures and sells in-house bearing equipment such as self-lubricating oilless bearings, structural equipment for bridges and buildings, and building equipment, and sells them to industrial machinery and automobile manufacturers and the construction sector in Japan and overseas.
